cards.ex: With the earthquake, the lives of many are still hanging in the balance as rescuers search for survivors.
cards.exUz: Zilzila tufayli qutqaruvchilar omon qolganlarni qidirar ekan, ko'plab odamlarning hayoti hali ham xavf ostida.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat juda xavfli, odamlarning o'lim xavfi borligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: The hurricane is expected to ravage the coastal areas with strong winds and heavy rainfall.
cards.exUz: Bo'ron kuchli shamol va kuchli yomg'ir bilan qirg'oq hududlarini vayron qilishi kutilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hududni butunlay vayron qilib tashlamoq, juda katta zarar yetkazmoq.

cards.ex: During a natural disaster, it's crucial to have resources to fall back on, like emergency supplies.
cards.exUz: Tabiiy ofat paytida favqulodda vaziyat uchun zarur bo'lgan resurslarga murojaat qilish juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Muammoli vaziyatda yordam olish uchun biror narsaga murojaat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The country managed to weather the economic storm caused by the pandemic.
cards.exUz: Mamlakat pandemiya tufayli kelib chiqqan iqtisodiy qiyinchilikni yengishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vaziyatni muvaffaqiyatli o'tkazib yubormoq, bardosh bermoq.

cards.ex: After the explosion, the city was in a state of chaos, with debris everywhere.
cards.exUz: Portlashdan so'ng shahar tartibsizlik holatiga tushdi, hamma joyda vayronalar bor edi.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyat juda tartibsiz va nazoratdan chiqqanligini anglatadi.

cards.ex: The abandoned buildings stand as a grim reminder of the earthquake that devastated the area.
cards.exUz: Tashlandiq binolar bu hududni vayron qilgan zilzilaning achchiq eslatmasi bo'lib turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Yomon yoki xavfli narsaning achchiq, yoqimsiz eslatmasi.

cards.ex: Many of the problems stem from a lack of preparedness for natural disasters.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina muammolar tabiiy ofatlarga tayyorgarlikning yo'qligidan kelib chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning sababi bo'lmoq, paydo bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The old bridge was on the brink of collapse after the heavy storm.
cards.exUz: Eski ko'prik kuchli bo'ronlardan keyin qulash arafasida edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir qulashga yoki muvaffaqiyatsizlikka juda yaqin bo'lgan holat.

cards.ex: The fire triggered a rapid response from the local fire department.
cards.exUz: Yong'in mahalliy o't o'chirish bo'limidan tezkor javobni keltirib chiqardi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning boshlanishiga yoki sodir bo'lishiga sabab bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: After the flood, the community had to rebuild their homes from scratch.
cards.exUz: Suv toshqinidan so'ng jamiyat o'z uylarini noldan qayta qurishga majbur bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Vayron bo'lgan narsani butunlay yangidan qayta qurmoq.

cards.ex: The news of the accident rippled through the small town, causing widespread grief.
cards.exUz: Baxtsiz hodisa haqidagi xabar kichik shaharchaga tarqalib, keng tarqalgan qayg'uga sabab bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik ta'sirdan boshlanib, asta-sekin katta ta'sirga ega bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The economic downturn was a crippling blow to small businesses in the region.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy tanazzul mintaqadagi kichik biznes uchun og'ir zarba bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta zarar yetkazadigan, halokatli zarba.

cards.ex: First responders are often in the line of fire when dealing with emergencies.
cards.exUz: Birinchi yordam ko'rsatuvchilar ko'pincha favqulodda vaziyatlarda xavf ostida bo'lishadi.
cards.uzDef: Xavfli vaziyatda, xavf ostida bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: The company was teetering on the brink of bankruptcy before the government intervened.
cards.exUz: Hukumat aralashuvidan oldin kompaniya bankrotlik yoqasida turgan edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir muvaffaqiyatsizlikka uchrash yoki qulash arafasida bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: Quick action by the firefighters helped avert a major catastrophe at the chemical plant.
cards.exUz: O't o'chiruvchilarning tezkor harakatlari kimyo zavodida katta halokatning oldini olishga yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yomon, halokatli vaziyatning oldini olmoq.

cards.ex: The government is grappling with the challenges of climate change and its impact.
cards.exUz: Hukumat iqlim o'zgarishi va uning ta'siri bilan bog'liq muammolar bilan kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin muammo yoki vaziyat bilan kurashmoq, uni hal qilishga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The house was damaged beyond recognition after the tornado hit.
cards.exUz: Uy tornado urganidan keyin tanib bo'lmas darajada shikastlangan edi.
cards.uzDef: Shunchalik o'zgargan yoki shikastlangan holatki, tanib bo'lmaydi.

cards.ex: The community rallied around the family who lost their home in the fire.
cards.exUz: Jamiyat yong'inda uyini yo'qotgan oilani qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun atrofga yig'ildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini yoki maqsadni qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun birga yig'ilmoq.

cards.ex: The threat of another hurricane looms large over the coastal communities.
cards.exUz: Yana bir bo'ron xavfi qirg'oq bo'yi jamoalariga katta tahdid solmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Muammoli yoki xavfli narsa, kelajakda katta muammo bo'lishi mumkin.

cards.ex: It will take years for the survivors to rebuild their lives after such a devastating earthquake.
cards.exUz: Omon qolganlarga bunday vayronkor zilziladan keyin o'z hayotlarini qayta qurish uchun yillar kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Ofatdan keyin hayotni tiklashga harakat qilmoq.

cards.ex: The weight of the recovery efforts rests on the shoulders of the local authorities.
cards.exUz: Tiklanish ishlarining og'irligi mahalliy hokimiyatlarning yelkasida turibdi.
cards.uzDef: Mas'uliyat yoki vazifani o'z zimmasiga olgan holda.

cards.ex: It's hard to grasp the scale of the destruction until you see it with your own eyes.
cards.exUz: Vayronagarchilikning miqyosini o'z ko'zingiz bilan ko'rmaguningizcha, tushunish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Muammoning yoki vaziyatning kattaligini to'liq anglamoq.

cards.ex: It's important to ensure that no one falls through the cracks during the emergency response.
cards.exUz: Favqulodda vaziyatlarda hech kimning e'tibordan chetda qolmasligini ta'minlash muhim.
cards.uzDef: Yordamga muhtoj bo'lsada, e'tibordan chetda qolmoq.

cards.ex: We just have to let the storm run its course and hope for the best.
cards.exUz: Biz shunchaki bo'ronning o'z yo'lidan borishiga ruxsat berishimiz va eng yaxshisiga umid qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsaning oxirigacha yetib borishiga ruxsat bermoq.

cards.ex: The rescue team managed to save several people against the odds.
cards.exUz: Qutqaruv guruhi qiyinchiliklarga qaramay bir necha kishini qutqarishga muvaffaq bo'ldi.
cards.uzDef: Katta qiyinchiliklarga qaramay, nimadirga erishmoq.

cards.ex: The fire razed the entire neighborhood to the ground.
cards.exUz: Yong'in butun mahallani yer bilan yakson qildi.
cards.uzDef: Butunlay vayron qilmoq, yer bilan bir xil qilmoq.

cards.ex: The city is now just a shadow of its former self after the earthquake.
cards.exUz: Shahar zilziladan keyin o'zining sobiq holatining soyasiga aylanib qoldi.
cards.uzDef: Avvalgidan ancha yomonroq holatda.

cards.ex: The quick response of the emergency services averted a major disaster.
cards.exUz: Favqulodda xizmatlarning tezkor javobi katta ofatning oldini oldi.
cards.uzDef: Juda yomon voqea sodir bo'lishining oldini olishga muvaffaq bo'lindi.

cards.ex: The aid organization is providing assistance on a massive scale to the affected areas.
cards.exUz: Yordam tashkiloti jabrlangan hududlarga katta miqyosda yordam ko'rsatmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta hajmda yoki miqdorda.

cards.ex: Rebuilding the city after the earthquake will require a Herculean effort.
cards.exUz: Zilziladan keyin shaharni qayta qurish ulkan harakatni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta va qiyin harakat.
